title: BrainRooms: Brainrot Backrooms

description: A short multiplayer kart-racing visit with NFEN and Stu, getting the lobby working and racing through chaotic meme-filled courses with noisy items and awkward shortcuts.
title: Brainrot Kart

description: A complete solo investigation of Laura Campbell’s abduction, alternating her escape attempts with Frank Morgan’s search. Organ-trafficking clues, stealth and Frank’s family memories lead through the final confrontation and resolution.
title: BROKEN MIND

description: A public-lobby tavern trial with viewers. Learn to grill grubs, fuel the tavern and serve customers, then juggle tickets, drinks and deliveries as the kitchen grows chaotic.
title: Bronzebeard's Tavern

description: A solo restaurant shift that turns into a Vietnamese crime thriller. Pho orders and village encounters lead to the masked club’s choices, reloaded branches and a combat-heavy resolution.
title: Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant

description: A solo VR trial of an extensive Backrooms sandbox. The long training route covers inventory, survival and traversal before exploration of Levels 0 and 1, the M.E.G. base and control frustrations.
title: BrVR: Backrooms Virtual Reality

title: BUCKSHOT ROULETTE

description: A solo run through the low-budget Backrooms, managing sanity and surviving chases before searching the later building for access cards and fixing the camera feeds. The early-access finish unlocks a brief Meme Rooms trial.
title: Budget Backrooms

description: A short solo Backrooms shooter trial, collecting guns and ammunition while fighting spongey entities and wrestling with mouse sensitivity. Later routes and the Obama encounter close the visit.
title: Bulletrooms

description: Solo ghost investigations from the control room, directing NPC investigators by voice and letting Twitch chat interfere. House, school and harder cases test evidence collection before a final manually controlled investigation.
title: Bump in the Night

description: Solo bunny hunting for a demanding king: track rabbits with a bow, load the catapult and meet increasingly strange royal quotas. The run reaches New Game Plus and ends with attempts at the long-distance archery achievement.
title: Bunny Hurling

description: A solo escape room inside a coffin, balancing dwindling light and oxygen against anxiety. After a failed attempt, the randomized locks, hidden switches and improvised tools finally lead out of the box.
title: Buried

description: Two solo visits to Jack’s crypt and cemetery. The first stops at the toolshed lock; the return solves the remaining graveyard and house puzzles, confronts the captor and rescues Hannah.
title: Buried Alive: Breathless Rescue

description: A solo journey from a dystopian processing facility into the city, following environmental storytelling and light puzzles to the final encounter. Dropped stream frames briefly affect the ending; locked chapter selection prevents a replay of that section.
title: Burning Daylight

aliases: BVOVB: Bruising Vengeance of the Vintage Boxer
description: Two solo visits to a vintage street brawler, following a retired boxer’s search for his stolen Rottweiler. The return pushes through difficult fights and boss retries to rescue Max.
title: BVOVB: Bruising Vengeance of the Vintage Boxer

description: Co-op extraction runs through a retro monster-infested wasteland. The first trial with NFEN and Stu introduces radio towers, relics and the bunker; the return adds APL for upgraded loadouts, harder missions and repeated extraction attempts.
title: C.A.S.T

description: A solo trial as a captive explorer, sent into the Backrooms to earn money for his son’s release. Hub instructions, loot collection and lockpicking are hampered by awkward interfaces; the visit ends without securing freedom.
title: C.I.E.B The Backrooms Project

description: A Christmas Prop Hunt session with SeaNanners, GoldGlove, ChilledChaos, CaptainSparklez, ZeRoyalViking and AllShamNoWow. Public matches alternate hunts with improvised prop hiding, decoys and risky stacking tricks.
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6

aliases: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War
description: Two squad Prop Hunt sessions with SeaNanners, APL, ChilledChaos, Diction and Bruce. Public matches turn into experiments with prop stacking, sloping into scenery and improbable hiding spots, alongside party and connection trouble.
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War

description: The original Verdansk Battle Royale with APL and Hutch. Trios work through drops, contracts, buy stations, loadouts and Gulag returns, with risky pushes and late-circle fights before the squad changes games.
title: Call of Duty: Warzone

description: A solo test of the body-camera shooter also labeled TacticCam. Broken menus and mode changes complicate the abandoned hospital and gym maps, leading to free-camera experiments and an early exit.
title: Cam

description: A solo psychological horror run through Jonathan’s repeating home. Medication, changed rooms and family memories lead to the truth about his wife and son and the final news report.
title: Can't Revert

description: A brief solo introduction to the Tucker farm is interrupted for a multiplayer game. The full return follows Henry through fixed-camera exploration, limited inventory, hiding and household puzzles to an escape ending.
title: Cannibal Abduction

description: A solo Backrooms sampler, testing the early levels and poolrooms while struggling with stamina, motion blur and limited control settings. The final retries end without escaping.
title: CantEscapeTheBackrooms

description: Solo anomaly hunting in a looping house, photographing missing objects and distorted rooms while avoiding hostile entities. The run clears the initial 13-anomaly target and returns for the tougher 20-anomaly challenge.
title: CAPTURED

description: Sark and Stu tackle a two-car obstacle course with boosts, jumps and plenty of failed landings. Targets, moving traps and the final hill lead to both cars reaching the town at the end.
title: Car Parkour Together

description: A solo attempt to escape a hungry killer’s puzzle-filled rooms, using a hamburger as a distraction. Machine solutions, Morse code and missing tiles occupy the run before Sark leaves the remaining puzzle unresolved.
title: Case Zero

description: A short co-op CashGrab trial with APL, collecting money while a spotlight-faced monster prowls the corridors. Dead-player cameras and a confusing elevator escape round out the visit before the pair changes games.
title: Cash Grab

description: Co-op cat adventures with Bruce, knocking over objects, collecting candy and helping the town. Monster portals, dungeon errands and a maze lead into more neighborhood quests before the pair moves on.
title: Cat Saves Halloween

description: Solo hurricane survival across four visits: the initial supply crisis, Mirror Lake and Solitude Point, an inventory-bug interruption, and a full return through the national park, Carl’s weather plot and the family reunion.
title: Category 6

description: Solo camera surveillance with Twitch chat spotting anomalies. Three maps move from the house to a hotel and factory, reporting altered objects and intruders until the morning.
title: Caught on Camera

description: Solo escape puzzles through John’s captivity in a remote lodge. The three chapters follow the first clues, a trip outside for fuel and power, and a return to the basement before the escape.
title: Caution Ahead: Part 1

description: Solo continuation of John’s escape, following radio contacts from the tower through a lake gate and underground passage. Chapters four through six lead from the camp and well to cave traps, chases and the ending.
title: Caution Ahead: Part 2

description: A solo investigation of a disappearance leads into a cave of unreliable memories and clown encounters. The run works through the door puzzle and confrontation, then revisits the ending choices.
title: Cave of Illusions

description: Solo inspection and salvage work in the Backrooms: film anomalies, classify findings and sell recovered goods. Hazmat upgrades and a gambling wheel compete for the profits while increasingly dangerous trips test the company’s rules.
title: Chained Backrooms

description: Co-op with NFEN and GassyMexican, solving linked platforming and room puzzles while chained together. The available three episodes progress through mannequins, red-light challenges and a gnome encounter before the cannon boss.
title: Chained in the Backrooms

description: Four-player Chained Together climbs indexed by run, mode, and progression.
title: Chained Together

description: A solo escape from a chalet after a blocked road and car trouble. House clues grow into map codes, keycards, plumbing and bridge repairs before the basement and a surreal return to the road.
title: Chalet

description: A solo police investigation inside a house, gathering equipment and following clues around a body and strange ritual objects. The final records reveal the case’s story before the ending.
title: Chaperone

description: A short solo trial of the punk brawler, testing combat, looted clothing and improvised limb weapons. Sark evaluates it as a possible future group game before moving on.
title: Charlie Murder

description: Co-op prison investigations with APL, Bruce and Diction, collecting stones and dealing with a pursuing entity. A failed first attempt gives way to a coordinated retry with guns, keys and the final banishment.
title: Chased by Darkness

description: Co-op with APL through an underwater facility, conserving ammunition while hacking doors and investigating its experiments. The route expands beyond the metro, ending in a lethal juggernaut encounter and discovery that the co-op run cannot be reloaded.
title: Chasmal Fear

description: Four rounds of screenshot trivia with Twitch chat, from tiny early images to larger pictures and increasingly competitive guesses. Host advantage, ambiguous screenshots and repeated promises of one last round become part of the contest.
title: Chat Guess Games

description: Solo early-access exploration of the Exclusion Zone, searching for Tatiana while building a refuge and recruiting companions. Missions, evidence, crafting and training continue across two visits; the planned final heist was not yet available in this version.
title: Chernobylite

description: A solo escape through a research facility stalked by the giant chicken Cooper. Chases and lift puzzles lead through Sebastian’s warnings, the gas sequence and the final escape.
title: Chicken Feet

description: Team battles with the pals, learning melee combat and experimenting with archery, rocks and catapults. Siege objectives, prisoner escapes and close ticket battles fill the opening visit and the available return footage.
title: Chivalry 2

description: Solo exploration of an island terrorized by a spider-legged locomotive. The first visit gathers eggs and train upgrades; the return finishes preparations, defeats Hell Charles and hunts down the remaining paint colors.
title: Choo-Choo Charles

description: A solo retro shooter across time, pursuing goblins from a museum through city streets, Transylvania, ancient Greece and the future. The run reaches the final boss and returns to the museum for the ending.
title: Chop Goblins

description: A solo alien mystery in a Hungarian town, searching for a missing twin sister. Fuel, village clues and a radio tower lead to the first episode’s ending, followed by its playable preview.
title: CHORDOSIS

description: Solo holiday slasher missions following Larry from the orphanage into an adult rampage directed by a talking Christmas tree. Stealth attempts and repeated attacks lead back to the orphanage and on to the institutional epilogue.
title: Christmas Massacre

description: A solo Christmas horror playthrough: Vanessa’s evening turns into Santa’s timed scavenger hunts, a search for a working phone, and a desperate attempt to signal the police.
title: Christmas Night

description: Connor’s solo New Year’s Eve playthrough, from fireworks and grocery shopping to the missing fuses, family revelations, and the final nightmare sequence.
title: Christmas Nightmare

description: Sark and APL hunt goats and keys, contend with AI teammates, and work up to a successful monster hunt before switching to the chupacabra side.
title: Chupacabras: Night Hunt

aliases: Civil Warfare: Another Bullet In The War
description: A broken multiplayer lobby attempt with Bruce, Diction, and Nanners, followed by Sark’s brief single-player look at the game.
title: Civil Warfare: Another Bullet In The War

description: The 2025 sequel to Ethel: Sark searches the Holden estate, wrestles with the book cipher across two visits, uncovers the family rituals, and plays both ending routes including the hidden fourth chapter.
title: Claire

title: Clausum

title: Climb The Backrooms

description: A short co-op backrooms attempt with NFEN, exploring the shifting maze and trying to break sight with the hunter.
title: Clipped Reality

description: A solo anomaly-spotting run with chat checking changing skies, reflections, and corridors. Repeated resets give way to a clean escape through the rotating environments.
title: Cloudrooms

description: Sark searches a carnival for his missing sister, collecting golden tickets and slipping past clowns with bottles, hammers, and bananas. Stream-safe music requests accompany the changing playable characters and the final revelation.
title: CLOWNCORE

description: A solo trip through an experimental game about pleasure and body awareness, exploring its surreal chambers and riding the final ascent.
title: CLTRS

description: Sark, NFEN, and Stu chant, scavenge dungeon ingredients, and prepare offerings for hungry kaiju. A successful first chapter gives way to a punishing second service full of stolen hearts and failed rescues.
title: Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking

description: 4 counted rides from Mr Sark's Wild Ride on 20 July 2020, indexed by attraction.
title: Coaster

description: A solo night shift that mixes passport checks, bedding, food orders, and temperature control with identifying and banishing possessed passengers. Sark gets through the tutorial before the carriage’s chores and awkward controls overwhelm him.
title: Conductor: Eternal Service

description: Solo attempts to keep a changing house under control with a camera and pills while solving room puzzles. Repeated sanity failures lead into the successful final run and the truth behind the family’s disappearance.
title: Confabulation

description: Sark follows detective Derek into a haunted mansion, searches for event triggers, and gets stuck trying to find the next step. The session closes with the discovery of an easily missed button.
title: CONFUSION

description: Sark and NFEN try a top-down jungle escape, sharing weapons and revives while hunting fuel and detonator parts. Two attempts at the road-blockage route end with the pair leaving the jungle behind.
title: Congo

description: Three solo visits to a cult’s cave, from bewildering maze exploration and debug-camera reconnaissance to a mapped return that finally reaches Chris and the ending.
title: Conquered Dread

description: Early-access co-op containment missions with Terroriser and Bruce: loadout experiments, friendly-fire mishaps, a disastrous first deployment, and another push through the facility’s tunnels.
title: Contain

title: Crab Game

description: Sark, APL, and NFEN crawl through the vents collecting dolls, surviving the first job before the later nights introduce more aggressive pursuers.

description: A brief solo VR boxing detour after the night’s other VR games: rapid punches, a dislodged headset, and a winded return from Rocky’s gym.

description: A solo camping trip turns into a forest and cave search, a night of feeding the fire, and a police account of the disappearance.

title: Crime Simulator

title: Cursed Exped

description: Two short attempts at the eight-page forest hunt: Sark first tries alone, then returns with Bruce, Diction, and Nanners for lobby problems, sudden deaths, and a page search.

description: Sark, NFEN, APL, and Gassy take on haunted heists in the early version of Dark Hours, learning the vault jobs and monsters before a successful extraction from the later job.
title: Dark Hours

description: Sark explores a STALKER-like shooter’s early areas, scavenging weapons and following commander, fuel, and patrol objectives. The run stops amid radio-tower and map-selection trouble.

title: DARKNESS ROLLERCOASTER

description: A short co-op submarine outing with NFEN, Stu, and APL. Looting and knife fights give way to jammed hatches, pumping, torpedo combat, and the surviving captain trying to recover his rat-shaped crewmates.
title: Darkwater

description: Sark’s earlier forest attempts lead into a fresh 2025–2026 playthrough. Scavenging, village errands, and increasingly elaborate IKEA furniture barricades carry him from the Dry Meadow through the Old Woods and swamp to the apparent happy ending.

description: A short multiplayer attempt with Bruce, Diction, and Nanners: switching out of German, opening a public server, and repeated crashes lead to Sark’s brief solo look around the room and balcony.
title: Das Balkonzimmer

description: A brief solo investigation of the cursed village, cut short by camera, inventory, and interaction problems. Sark retries the opening and gas station before moving on.
title: Dawn of Hell

description: Two solo visits to a parasite-detection puzzle game: Sark places sensors, deduces which residents are infected, and survives the hallucinations. The return visit demonstrates the later rules before he samples the developer’s other games.
title: Days Like A Nightmare

description: A solo search through an abandoned shipwreck, collecting fuses and hospital clues, solving a door code, and looking for the last route forward before leaving the investigation unfinished.
title: Dead Abyss

description: A short solo zombie-survival attempt in a suburban house. Sark tries improvised safe spots, checks the hour-based goals, and experiments with the revolver before quitting the run.
title: Dead by Headshot

description: A solo occult road trip to collect a book, bell, and candle. Repeated crashes, fuel stops, and scratch-card detours accompany Sark’s unsettling drive toward the witch.
title: Dead End Road

description: Sark works the supermarket’s midnight shifts alone, ringing up strange customers, cleaning and restocking, and investigating the store’s eerie back rooms before the final toy search.
title: Dead of Night: Supermarket

description: A solo first-night attempt at surveillance reporting and shady deliveries. Sark learns the camera categories, door codes, and assassins, then lowers the difficulty and retries before leaving the shift unfinished.
title: Dead Signal

description: A solo run through the Japanese girls’ school recording in the 2025 found-footage game by Joure Visser. Sark changes tape speed, collects keys, fights with a shotgun and katana, and works through the safe, samurai encounter, and final artifacts.

title: Deadly Broadcast

title: Deadly Nightmare

description: Sark tries the Deadly Nightmare sequel immediately after the first game. More family lore gives way to another mansion-wide ingredient hunt, healing and time-freezing spells, and an unsuccessful attempt to assemble the curse ritual.
title: Deadly Nightmare Unwanted Heritage

description: Sark and NFEN run an asymmetrical prison shift, exchanging inmate details, cooking and sending meals, operating security, and helping one another survive supernatural threats. Hidden computer records accompany the climb to a flawless day ten and a failed confidential challenge.
title: Death in Unison

description: Sark investigates the Crimson Motel alone, reading its case notes, opening briefcases for VHS tapes, and filming the haunted rooms. The investigation ends amid stalled progress and computer-interface problems.
title: Death Motel

title: Death Relives

description: A solo escape from a livestreamed torture game. Doors, roulette, and a changing safe code give way to a screwdriver, tracker, coin toss, and repeated van-escape experiments before Sark finally completes the escape.
title: Death Stream

description: A short co-op escape with Stu, using the swap mechanic to trade places with the monster and keep the other player moving. An initial interaction problem gives way to coordinated button, keycard, and surgery-tool routes.
title: Death Swap: End As One

description: Sark learns the dinosaur-survival controls alone, then joins Emerome, NFEN, and APL for stealthy facility jobs. Hacking, fuses, bio-scans, revives, and an egg extraction turn into frantic encounters with the dinosaurs.

description: A brief solo reconnaissance dive before a possible co-op return. Sark enters the Arctic cave system, follows Sonya’s route, and recharges from the squid ROV before stopping the exploratory run.
title: Debris

description: A solo week as a debugger at Dokiyoki Games: Sark spots malfunctioning objects in a house level while the office’s strange relationships unfold. Getting fired prompts a retry that reaches the happy ending, followed by further ending experiments.
title: DEBUG DEADLINE

description: Two solo journeys through the killer-car city, following payphones and piecing together the family story. Sark completes the first route, then returns in New Game Plus for more dangerous vehicles and the final truck chase.

description: Mining and salvage missions with NFEN, preceded by a short solo return to the caves. The crew tries different classes, repairs mini-MULEs, collects minerals and eggs, and fights through swarms toward extraction.
title: Deep Rock Galactic

description: Two solo visits to an anomaly-spotting bedroom game. Sark keeps himself awake by clicking altered objects, then battles the clown’s blackjack, rock-paper-scissors, and roulette challenges when the sleep meter wins.
title: Deep Sleep

description: Sark, NFEN, and Stu complete the PillCorp prologue separately before joining a shared memory. Cameras, lockpicks, pitfalls, and the bacteria entity make the first backrooms exploration a short and frustrating attempt.
title: Deja Vu: The Backrooms

description: A long forest investigation with APL, later joined by Stu. The crew searches for tiny keys, candles, matches, and hoofprint clues, works out how to repel the demon, and finally completes the ritual.
title: Demonic Episode

description: Sark, APL, and Stu try the forest’s armed mutant hunt, then switch to the demon-investigation mode. Equipment searches, strange creatures, mutant fluids, and a sustained cross attack eventually produce a successful demon hunt.
title: Demonsomnia

description: A solo look through a surreal collection of puzzle rooms, repeatedly interrupted by broken controls and restarts. Sark repairs the truck, adjusts the submarine and tree mechanisms, and completes the room sequence before reviewing its abrupt conclusion.
title: Departure

description: A solo descent through a research facility, mine tunnels, and the woods in the 2025 horror game. Sark collects keys and notes while repeatedly trying to get past a fast pursuer, then leaves the final forest search unfinished.
title: Descent

description: Sark attempts to launch this game during Mr Sark's Wild Ride on 20 July 2020, but the ride does not start. The failed attempt is preserved.
title: Desert Ride Coaster

description: A short solo test followed by a longer return to the desert sniper simulator. Sark learns the scope and wind calculations, hits the thousand-meter target, and hunts mission targets through the town’s buildings.
title: Desert Witch

description: The mapped Desolate co-op archive with APL Fisher, covering a 2020 continuation and the 2022 restart on Hard.
title: Desolate

description: A solo run through Anna’s mansion and catacombs, managing limited saves, ammunition, and inventory space. Acid mixing, gunpowder, keys, and mechanisms lead to the final confrontation with Lillian Shelby.
title: Despair: Blood Curse

description: Sark's complete two-stream Community Play run of Detroit: Become Human, with Twitch viewers voting on story decisions throughout the branching playthrough.
title: Detroit: Become Human

title: DEVOUR

description: Sark, APL, and Bruce sample the horror game’s different maps. Loading failures, broken doors, and abrupt deaths interrupt the factory, haunted house, and village attempts.

title: Diddy

description: A two-visit co-op expedition with APL through linked hostile dimensions. Keys, valves, crystals, laser relays, skulls, and the slow-moving guide lead to the sky platform; the return finishes its puzzles and then secures the good ending by destroying the remaining relics.

description: A short solo look at the backrooms levels, searching for food, water, and keys while trying unusual room mechanics. Sark samples the later maze before moving on rather than attempting all 45 levels.
title: Dimension Omega

title: Dimensional Phobos Threat

title: Dirge

description: A co-op musical disaster with APL, swapping between recorder, violin, trombone, and cello. Familiar classical pieces become a competition to keep the pitch and the score from falling apart.
title: Disaster Band

description: Twenty-one IRL disc-golf streams from February 2025 through March 2026, preserving early phone-stream tests, solo and guest rounds, course context, scores, and conditions where the footage supports them.

description: Four-player rounds with APL, Stu, and NFEN, comparing disc bags, trying risky lines, and battling the wind, water, and out-of-bounds areas across different courses.
title: Disc Golf Valley

description: A short co-op temple investigation with APL and Bruce. The crew uses camera flashes against the pharaoh and searches the dark rooms for hidden staves, then abandons the unfinished run.
title: Disembowel

description: A solo wander through vacant backrooms, hotel spaces, and an airport. Sark experiments with the tape effects, follows elevators and unfamiliar passages, and leaves further achievement hunting for another visit.
title: Disminal

description: A solo night shift as Grace, working through office tasks while increasingly disturbing events unfold. Sark investigates files, security messages, and an intruder before reaching the escape and closing review.
title: DISTURBING FEARS - Workplace

description: A short solo exploration of a surreal island landscape. Sark experiments with movement, retraces platforms and paths, and samples the map before moving on with more left to explore.
title: DitherDream

description: A brief solo look at megane’s hotel horror game. Sark explores dark corridors and doors with a flashlight, then leaves the unsettling loop unfinished.
title: Do Not Disturb

description: A solo neighborhood horror story about a strange dog and a forgotten pet. Sark follows daily tasks, encounters an enormous dog, and reaches the Pochi revelations and final conversations.
title: DogDogDog

description: A short multiplayer attempt with APL, Bruce, Diction, and SeaNanners. Lobby and connection problems eventually give way to a little doge combat before the crew moves on.
title: DogeFight

description: A short solo sample of dog parkour before the evening’s group games. Sark tries the movement abilities, moving platforms, and unusual jumping controls.
title: Dogs Club
