description: A brief solo look at UGGPL Games’ found-footage Backrooms game. Sark enters the portal, searches the maze and batteries, tests the awkward controls and leaves after discussing the game’s reviews.
title: Kenophobia

description: A solo playthrough of gieko’s short kidnapping horror game. Sark gets an early bad ending, restarts to recover the seven borrowed games and reaches the news-report ending after the final closet search.
title: Kidnappers

description: Two playthroughs of Team17’s earlier game-jam prototype, recorded in 2020. Chat helps choose the callers’ survival advice; Sark then restarts to correct the routes, save all three callers and barricade the studio.
title: Killer Frequency

description: Three solo visits to the hand-drawn shooter. Sark previews the opening and combat simulator, returns to finish the first mission, then revisits the game after off-stream progress to play more missions, challenge objectives and the final boss ending.
title: KINGDOM of the DEAD

description: Feed the meat-powered elevator, descend the Gigastructure, and try to survive long enough to reach the heart at Floor 100.
title: KLETKA

description: A co-op medieval horror session with Emerome, NFEN and StuStutters. The crew explore the village, attempt honour quests and gather supplies, then return after a party wipe to test another route before moving on.
title: Knights End

description: A solo attempt to escape the shifting Kowloon alleys. Sark searches for five mirrors, learns the compass and steam-valve routes, retries after deaths and stops with the escape unfinished.
title: Kowloon Labyrinth

description: A solo Christmas-horror shooter playthrough. Sark fights through the house, sewers and snowy neighbourhood, survives the underworld’s repeated combat trials and destroys the naughty list. He then tries Hide and Seek and Survival mode.
title: Krampus Kills

description: A solo tour through the shifting mansion: Sark rebuilds its scale model, evades the bronze figure, solves the portrait puzzle and reaches the finale.
title: Kraven Manor

description: A short solo scavenging trip into the post-apocalyptic fog. Sark follows the map, searches for Ordostones and discovers what is stalking him and his companion.
title: Krysolov

description: Solo wave runs built around escalating turret upgrades, persistent unlocks and Big Joe’s chicken helicopter. A later return tests a patch released during the same broadcast.
title: KunKun Defender

description: The four-player introduction with NFEN, Stu and APL leads into a long solo upgrade grind and a final showcase of the maxed-out turret build.
title: KUNKUN Defender 2

description: A brief solo sampler precedes the full co-op return with APL. They work through the dream’s keys, basketball shots, picture puzzles, supermarket and laptop videos before reaching the credits.
title: KunKun dream Startles the Soul

description: Three solo blocks through an abandoned Chinese school. Sark deciphers its puzzles, endures repeated resets, finds grandma’s gift and finally defeats the Black Mountain Demon before the musical epilogue.
title: Kunkunkun

description: A solo prison escape through a long key hunt, the failed-exit ending, an unresolved dark maze and the basketball route that leads to the dream ending.
title: KunKunPrison

description: A solo anomaly hunt through Kyoto’s looping backstreets. Sark learns the routes, shrine rules and coin hunt, reaches the regular ending and reviews the other endings.
title: Kyoto Anomaly

description: A short co-op visit with Stu, NFEN and a later-arriving APL: overloaded menus, carried bodies, a lobby restart and the search for a key and a working door.
title: LAB 47

description: Sark, APL and Diction enter the hedge maze, assemble the password and advance to the stone-seal hunt. The visit ends with that second section unfinished.
title: LABYRINTHINE

description: A solo archaeological descent through pyramid puzzles and death traps. Sark collects the ritual objects, enters the alien realm and reloads to see both endings.
title: Lair of Anubis

description: A co-op Backrooms run with NFEN and Gassy. Weapons, keys and floppy disks lead to the terminal gates and a dreamlike escape ending.
title: Lamentations

description: Sark takes the E.R.D.’s six-module training program: entity identification, audio tests and field directives lead into a final exam with a personal surprise.
title: Lancaster Leak: Entity Exam

description: Sark covers a night security shift, photographs anomalies floor by floor, and reads the building’s archived shift records before making one last patrol.
title: Last Call

description: A solo trip aboard the closing train line. Sark explores the looping carriages, follows the key and locker codes and pulls the lever to escape.
title: Last Departure

description: A co-op Backrooms visit with Stu. They collect notes, manage sanity and almond water, search increasingly dark corridors and leave without a clear completed objective.
title: Last Expedition

description: A solo stay at a roadside motel with a suspicious concierge, a stalled car repair and warnings about Room 8. Sark follows the story through the final departure.
title: Last Guest

description: A solo night shift verifying park-camera reports. Strange footage and radio calls grow into a hunt for the heart, a final report decision and the void ending.
title: Last Report

description: Sark and APL dodge sound-sensitive creatures, restore power and open the escape gate. The vehicle escape is followed by a review of the run’s deafening screams.
title: Lastbane

description: Two solo visits follow an amnesiac’s journey from an endless laundromat through cults, forests, nightmares and camera tests to the virtual-world revelation, ending and replay exploration.
title: Laundry Room Dilemma

description: A solo psychedelic breakfast adventure. Sark explores colorful worlds, collects the friendship-ship fuel and helps the Space Lemmings from Space get home.
title: LAVALAMP

description: The Last Stand campaign with APL, Hutch and AllShamNoWow: expert realism gives way to repeated difficulty adjustments, lighthouse finale attempts and a successful boat escape.
title: Left 4 Dead 2

description: A solo hunting trip turns into shotgun fights with a forest cult. Sark learns the relic stun, repeatedly retries the fast enemy waves and reaches Leshy’s closing dialogue.
title: Leshy Prelude

description: Quota-driven Lethal Company archive. Each group is an employment run; chapters follow the run's quota/deadline cycles and major run-ending pivots, with source VOD boundaries kept underneath the content.
title: Lethal Company

description: Two solo visits follow Paul Ritewood’s tapes through the poolrooms. The first stalls at the mall; the return finds the exit and ends with a demonstration of the permanent broken-leg mechanic.
title: Level 37: The Ritewood Anomaly

description: Three Liar's Bar sessions covering Sark and the crew learning Liar's Deck and Liar's Dice, teaching a new table the games, and returning for the later Chaos ruleset update.
title: Liar's Bar

description: Solo ghost-survival attempts use lights, the flashlight and bear traps to last until morning. Sark tests the phone and trap mechanics before moving on.
title: Light the Backrooms

description: A short solo attempt reads the research-base lore, struggles with the survival meters and explores the surrounding block-built maze. Sark stops to inspect the trailer and reviews rather than finish the game.
title: LIMB: Origins

description: A brief solo tour cycles through the retro rooms, gets caught by their inhabitants and searches for the remaining hospital map before calling the session.
title: Liminal 98

description: A solo exploration of the endless city moves through its streets, interior spaces, sewers and other levels. The late chase leads to an escape and a look at the remaining achievements.
title: Liminal City

description: Sark and chat build a hospital mind palace, clear normal and hard modes, then attempt the timed escape achievement.
title: Liminal Department

description: An initial solo maze attempt becomes a co-op run with NFEN. They face weeping angels, follow colored lights, cross floating platforms, work through pipes and valves, collect gas cans and solve the final object-count code.
title: LIMINAL ESCAPE

description: Sark searches liminal shops, corridors, grass rooms and parking areas for doors and keys, survives the watching enemy and the dinosaur-like pursuer, and follows the route to its final blackout.
title: Liminal: Escape Route

description: Chat helps Sark inspect looping corridors, pools and industrial rooms. The run reaches the good ending, followed by a brief investigation of the missing Bliss ending.
title: Liminal Exit

description: A solo attempt explores the first interconnected rooms, finds item-gated routes and puzzles, then stops with more of the game left for unfinished business.
title: Liminal Explorer

description: A solo surreal stroll moves from colorful domestic scenes into stranger dream spaces, movie references and a final apparent crash.
title: Liminal Lane

description: A solo walk and swim through the pool labyrinth follows the scattered pool-boy notes, the goddess’s story and a jet-ski departure.
title: Liminal Salvation

description: A long solo dream-space journey spans two visits. Sark maps the branching poolrooms by hand, follows the later plushie and key rooms, then retraces the route for the other ending.
title: LIMINAL SHIFT

description: A solo journey through the shroud moves from an eerie park into pipe tunnels, party-room puzzles, warehouse spaces and low-gravity vistas. After the ending, Sark revisits the opening to discuss how it began.
title: Liminal Shroud

description: A solo tour of the map selector searches the airport for its missing memento, escapes the neighborhood and briefly checks the backrooms map.
title: Liminal Space

description: A relaxed solo holiday follows family messages, oil paintings and rubber-duck hunts through the hotel, poolrooms, beach, dog rooms and a trip into space before waking up.
title: Liminal Space Holiday

description: A brief solo preview explores the surreal dream spaces before Sark removes it from the Backrooms project and saves it for a future psychedelic-game session.
title: Liminal Spaces: Outside The Backrooms

description: A short solo maze escape: Sark searches the poolrooms for keys, meets the pursuing entity, works out the colored switch sequence and reaches the portal ending.
title: Liminal: The Forgotten Maze

description: A solo color-key hunt repeatedly runs into trouble with the blue door. Sark stops when the required gold key remains inaccessible and the game will not quit normally.
title: Liminal Underground: Creatures Beyond

description: A solo walk through the huge liminal environments begins with restrained interiors and grows into long open-air routes. Sark reaches the final door and reviews the sparse achievements.
title: Liminal Universe

description: A solo tour through the pool facility and its stranger extensions: hotel corridors, the Forgotten Realm, ancient caves, Still Waters origins, galleries and the desert temple. Sark reaches the ending and returns to inspect the route and remaining achievements.
title: LIMINAL WATERS

description: Sark follows a drowned man’s surreal descent through poolrooms and faded memories, then wrestles with the infinite stairs. After reaching chapter five, he revisits the stair route and checks the chapter-select results.
title: Liminalcore

description: Sark tests the liminal exploration stages, wrestles with movement and wall climbing, visits the museum and underwater spaces, and investigates the sandbox tools and file permissions before leaving the unfinished run.
title: LIMSCAPE

description: A brief test of an audio-only first-person shooter. Sark reads the controls, discovers how to start single-player and tries navigating and firing without a visual interface before moving on.
title: Listen

description: Sark and APL search Jake’s haunted house, restore power and hunt for the key and ritual supplies. They survive the hostile girl and finish the fireplace ritual after a prolonged search for candles and water.
title: Little Devil

description: A viewer-controlled party-game session with naval coin tosses, a bridge challenge, a memory board, red light / green light and a final free-for-all brawl.
title: Little Fighters on Stream

description: A complete solo run through Neural Net Solutions’ corrupted virtual vacation. Sark explores the simulation’s worlds, escapes its pursuers, solves the bell and statue puzzles, upgrades his stamina and follows the final wake-up instructions before touring the concept gallery.
title: Loathful

description: A surreal solo journey from a deceptively peaceful village into distorted dream spaces. Sark works through the cryptic dialogue and looping realities, survives the strange obstacle routes and hunts the invisible entities before the closing sequence.
title: Lobotomy

description: Three attempts to investigate Nessie: the first with Bruce and Diction, a solo recon visit, and a later return with Bruce and NFEN. Rowing, equipment handling, failed evidence searches and the pocket Pong game repeatedly get in the way.
title: Loch Ness

description: Three social-deduction sessions with changing groups of pals. The crew learns station tasks, adjusts the round settings and repeatedly undermines its own work with accusations, improvised weapons, sabotage and betrayals.
title: LOCKDOWN Protocol

description: Sark tries the Twitch-integrated anomaly surveillance game, configures the reporting commands and tests the gallery cameras. The session ends after chat’s reports fail to work reliably.
title: Look Closer!

description: Sark, Bruce, Diction and APL attempt the fragile egg platforming courses. The classroom protractor and long plank bridge become a prolonged series of retries; the group takes a quick look at the last stage before leaving the run unfinished.
title: Lost Egg 2: Be Together

description: Sark, Hutch, Bruce, NFEN and APL tackle the egg courses with viewer assistance. After the vase stage and previews of later courses, Sark reaches the final stage’s ending, then watches APL continue the plank challenge.
title: LOST EGG 3: The Final

description: A short solo attempt at the echolocation mansion. Sark uses sound to reveal rooms, searches for the valve and fuel, and abandons the escape attempt after another death and reset.
title: Lost Files 1978

description: A solo story run through the tutorial, laboratory puzzles, Level Fun and the later minigames reaches its closing sequence. Sark returns with NFEN for the separate expedition mode, exploring its hostile rooms, artifact spaces and pool areas.
title: Lost Hope: Backrooms

description: Sark searches a surreal mall for his missing daughter, follows compass clues, collects batteries and works out the malfunctioning TV route. The final chase leads to the escape-for-now ending.
title: Lost In Static

description: The first attempt fails on a missing executable. On the return visit Sark demonstrates that he finally got the game running, recognizes its familiar reused course and leaves it in the completed pile without replaying the route.
title: Lost in the Backrooms

description: A co-op journey with NFEN through hostile corridors, Partygoer retries, a no-running level, generators, water valves and a 23-tape hunt. They reach an ending, then discover that most level achievements did not unlock.
title: Lost in the Backrooms: Day 100

description: Sark and APL build a survival raft, gather island resources and try to recover their stranded vessel. The opening and continuation survive across a split recording.
title: Lost World

description: A four-player rescue attempt turns into a mansion-wide hunt for keys, fuel and dolls. Sark and the crew burn the cursed dolls, rescue teammates and face the closing zombie rush.
title: Love in the Dark

description: Sark explores Site 12A through a found-footage camera, hunts notes and codes in the maze, then searches the poolrooms for a route onward. The visit ends with the route unresolved.
title: Lumenile: Found Footage

description: A solo lunar mystery spanning three stream dates: oxygen and rover troubles at the present-day base lead into a retro research facility, its AI and the final escape launch.
title: Lunar Nightmare

description: Sark, APL, Bruce and Diction steal exam answers while dodging the Lunch Lady. The archive preserves the initial audio-troubled attempt and the subsequent school escapes, using the clearer recording for the main runs.
title: Lunch Lady

description: Sark and APL attempt a haunted-house escape built around sanity, fuses, wiring and a numbered lock. Repeated deaths, desynchronization and the last code attempts bring the visit to a close.
title: Lurch

aliases: Lust For Darkness VR: M Edition
description: Sark plays the VR M Edition through its cult mansion, Lusst’ghaa puzzles and the search for Amanda and her child. The troublesome boss sequence gives way to a night-vision breakthrough and the closing epilogue.
title: Lust For Darkness VR: M Edition

description: Sark plays Lust from Beyond: M Edition across two nights. Victor’s visions lead from Bleakmoor and Eden Theater to rival cults, the search for Lily and the final confrontation in Lusst’ghaa, followed by ending review.
title: Lust from Beyond

description: Two multiplayer visits full of physics brawls, oversized characters, awkward specials and unstable lobbies. The first crew includes SeaNanners; APL joins Bruce and Diction for the return.
title: Mad Streets

description: Sark, Emerome, NFEN and Stu play mafia-themed dice hands with role effects and escalating gun chambers. Bluffs, unlikely rolls and a long duel punctuate the closing matches.
title: Mafioso's Dice

description: A surreal point-and-click visit built around odd household objects, machines, a five-digit safe and symbolic rooms. Sark reaches the unfinished continuation screen before moving to another game.
title: Magnus Positive Phototaxis

description: Sark, APL and Diction collect runes and summon weapons against demons. Their hunts cover the initial map, harder hospital attempts, sewers, a bunker and a final costumed run.
title: Malum

description: Sark explores the abandoned Wonderland, survives a softlock and restart, works through a maze and safe, then faces the bakery and its chasing mascots. The visit ends before the adventure is completed.
title: Mango's Wonderland

description: A captive detective searches Manivore’s house through toy-train parts, photographs, clocks, books and hidden rooms. The family mystery leads to the cellar and the final eat-or-refuse decision.
title: Manivore

description: Sark takes a factory contract and works through escalating mannequin-production shifts. Deaths reset earlier days; the final shift leads to the rabbit hole, a number sequence and Ending A: Rebirth.
title: Mannequin Machine

description: Fishing on a deserted island leads Sark into an impossible burger restaurant. The search for seven seals, Petrovsky’s revelations and a makeshift weapon build toward Tyler’s escape and the final kaiju confrontation.
title: Manny's

description: Sark takes a camcorder into Maple Island’s forest to find cow idols. Shrines, strange portals and the pillar realm lead to an ominous salvation prompt and ending review.
title: Many Eyed

description: Four early Marathon sessions following Sark from the opening Tau Ceti lore and first extraction runs through faction progression, a solo Perimeter warm-up, Outpost attempts, Cryo Archive, and increasingly confident duo runs.
title: Marathon

description: The complete Sarkive Marbles on Stream race archive.
title: Marbles on Stream

description: An interrogation gives way to bugs, Alastor’s shifting dimension and a bronze bull. Sark works through the tears puzzle and final password before reviewing the short horror story.
title: Martyrdom

description: Sark follows cinema staff and patrons through a Halloween slasher story: concessions, cleaning, the arcade, a murderous clown and the final escape. He then tries the separate theater simulation mode.
title: Massacre at the Mirage

description: Two hide-and-seek sessions with a large crew of pals. Players paint their bodies to match the Backrooms, hunt imperfect disguises and return for the museum’s Mona Lisa impersonations.
title: MECCHA CHAMELEON

description: Sark learns six-axis mech combat, survives the Wave of Death and tracks down Dad before taking the mission into space.
title: MECH PUNK

aliases: Medal of Honor: Above and Beyond
description: Sark takes the VR campaign from weapons training through Resistance missions and aerial combat, then returns for the train assault and Normandy landings. The surviving sessions stop during the campaign.
title: Medal of Honor: Above and Beyond

description: Sark and APL defend a medieval village against oversized attackers, revive each other and experiment with spears, siege weapons and ways to reach the witch.
title: MEDIEVAL KNIGHTMARE

description: Sark builds Banana Cat around fish, healing and tear pools, survives the full thirty-minute run and briefly tries the newly unlocked Cheems.
title: Meme Survivors: Backrooms

description: Sark follows a mission through bones, forest and caves in an Iron Lung-inspired horror game. The run ends after he becomes stuck in a narrow cave opening.
title: Metal Casket

description: Sark awakens the Guardian and fights through desert ruins, the temple and sewers. A freezing bug interrupts a boss attempt before a workaround carries the run to the credits.
title: Metamorphos

description: Sark runs out of fuel, enters the cursed village and experiments with a violent escape route. After stealing a car and restarting, he finds a shortcut and races through a two-minute-forty-eight-second run.
title: MidNight Cemetery

description: Sark and the crew alternate between hunting haunted props and surviving until midnight. Two visits develop trap, corruption and poltergeist tactics, with Gassy joining late in the first visit.
title: Midnight Ghost Hunt

description: Sark learns the office-heist tutorial, robs haunted workplaces with APL and brings Stu into the later jobs. Hacking, loot collection and escapes give way to an audio problem that ends the session.
title: Midnight Heist

description: Sark and the crew try a pitch-black gunfight, then switch to the skull-totem mode before returning to a final deathmatch with slot-machine powerups.
title: Midnight Murder Club

description: Sark learns to stomp jellybeans, climbs the score ranks and reaches the final rewards in a short arcade session.
title: Midsummer Leg's Dream

description: Sark investigates a roadside killing, loses his first attempt to a passing car and starts again. Town clues lead to a cabin and an armed encounter with the mimic.
title: Mimic Search

description: Sark hunts posters through the clown maze, sees the bad endings and retries the Ringmaster route. A duplicated-model bug forces another restart before the final burning sequence reaches the good ending.
title: Mind the Clown

description: Sark and NFEN's five-attempt Hardcore Minecraft run, mapped by progression from the first fresh world through the successful Ender Dragon kill and post-victory build.
title: Minecraft

description: Sark and NFEN explore Float Studios’ Bedrock Backrooms map, gathering six keys across the offices, hotel, Academy, pools and pipe tunnels. A walkthrough helps resolve the hidden final keys before they unlock the exit and reach the apartment.
title: Minecraft: The Backrooms

description: Sark works through a layered mirror mystery built around an in-game computer and the Propaganda network. Organ and photograph puzzles lead to radio clues, family memories, coded names, poisons and the final board challenge across three broadcasts.
title: Mirror Layers

description: Sark follows looping rooms and neural-therapy memories, makes the flower and teddy choices and retries a failed branch. The car-crash revelations lead to a hospital ending.
title: MIRROR MIRROR

description: Sark and the crew scavenge a radioactive wasteland, wire their bunker and work through crafting, farming and dangerous supply runs. A later return expands the base while bandits and anomalies interrupt the looting.
title: MISERY

description: Sark drives out to look for his missing brother, asks questions at the gas station and follows the mountain trail. A suspicious camp and cabin lead to the short horror ending.
title: Missing Hiker

description: Sark repairs a stranded tractor and follows a radio signal in the 2024 horror game. A restart, strange conversation and lamp preparations lead to a death that kicks him back to the desktop.
title: Mist

description: Sark learns to survive the infected countryside, establishes shelter and raids camps for supplies. Cooking and storage lead to restoring a car, exploring by road and a final collision during a raider encounter.
title: Mist Survival

description: Sark, Bruce and Nick search the neighborhood chief’s house for keys and chest tools. Repeated escapes and lobby retries culminate in a VIP effort to get Sark out.
title: Misteri Rumah Pak RT

description: Sark follows Emily into Mayan ruins, explores the catacombs and temple, reaches the missing-siblings ending and returns for the last achievement.
title: MITNAL

description: Sark learns the randomized ship and its three monsters, repeatedly tries escape equipment and earns raft and helicopter escapes across four surviving visits.
title: Monstrum

description: Sark, Etalyx, Diction and Bruce alternate between monsters and prisoners, learn power objectives and play with visiting developers before Sark tries the monster tutorial.
title: Monstrum 2

description: Sark and APL steal office supplies while watching a pursuing monster on security screens. Two layouts and a return attempt end with the last key still missing.
title: Mop of the Dead

description: Sark follows Justina through a wartime prison, collects keys and gears and works through scales, saw and statue puzzles before reaching the rooftop and closing story sequence.
title: Mortanis Prisoners

description: Sark, APL and Stu repeatedly hunt the Mothman with guns, traps and bait. Failed ambushes and broken lobbies give way to a successful final hunt.
title: Mothman

description: Sark explores Antarctic caves as William Dyer, learns rope and ice-pick climbing and reaches a camp. A progression failure resets the level and ends the attempt.
title: Mountains of Madness

description: Sark plays the live-action story mode, investigates a death among the lodge guests, and revisits the Underground Grotto to try another final choice.
title: Mourningwood Lodge

description: Sark explores a surreal house and the worlds inside its mouths, brushes teeth and solves stranger puzzles as the days pass toward a dentist ending.
title: MOUTHOLE

description: Sark troubleshoots a broken menu and enters an experimental interview loop. Cards, medicine choices, hallucinations and counting tasks eventually return him to the opening.
title: Moved Mind

description: Sark, APL and Bruce learn survival crafting and struggle through successive nights. After the crew leaves, Sark joins a viewer lobby for one more run that ends in a guardian wipe.
title: Muck

description: Sark enters a Moroccan village after a flat tire, investigates Aisha’s curse and follows the cemetery guard’s instructions to break it and escape by car.
title: Mule of Graves Morrocan Horror

description: Sark investigates his grandfather’s death, climbs from the valley through hay deliveries, beekeepers and wartime visions, and uncovers the family bargain before the final descent and credits.
title: Mundaun

description: Sark tries the haunted gallery, matches paintings to labels and begins the first night’s mystery before leaving the investigation unfinished.
title: Murderous Muses

description: Sark, APL, Bruce and Gassy learn submarine navigation and corpse disposal, explore successive underwater labs and buy upgrades while dodging monsters and police.
title: Murky Divers

description: Sark and APL carry glass through traffic and construction obstacles, progressing through the delivery jobs to the final level and credits.
title: My Coworker is an Idiot

description: Sark repairs a defunct puppet studio on Survival difficulty, explores its soundstages and offices and works through the park and art puzzles to the ending. After the credits he experiments with the unlocked free camera and spawning crayons.
title: My Friendly Neighborhood

description: Sark reads Jessica and Denise’s holiday visual novel, follows Yoro and the money conflicts and reaches the passport crisis, rescue and return to Leeds.
title: My Gambian Boyfriend

description: Sark explores the cursed house, solves painting and piano clues and retrieves Grandpa’s missing parts. A good ending leads to another attempt with randomized clues and a different outcome.
title: My Grandparent's House

description: Sark experiments with an elaborate character editor, joins the Black Sword Sect and tries combat and flying-sword travel before abandoning the island exploration.
title: My Xiuxiuan World

description: Sark and Stu learn extraction contracts, gather mycelium and face teleporters, mimic signals and quota failures. A later four-player return adds APL and Nick for more short expeditions.
title: Mycelium: The Silent Contract

description: Sark works the isolated gas station night shift, investigates unsettling visitors and camera reports, and hides from the returning woman until the police arrive.
title: Mystic Rest Stop

description: Sark's MythForce archive follows the first co-op learning night with APL and NFEN, then a four-player return with Bruce Greene, Diction and SeaNanners that becomes a trio and pushes all the way to the first boss.
title: MythForce

aliases: Nancy Drew: Mystery of the Seven Keys
description: Sark investigates the substituted necklace in Prague, interviews suspects and works through café and museum puzzles. A short return solves the library compass before the unfinished case is set aside.
title: Nancy Drew: Mystery of the Seven Keys

description: Sark competes in Pacific Run in New Zealand, collects medallion pieces and investigates the sabotaged bridge. The contest puzzles lead to Kiri’s confrontation, the star lenses and Nancy’s concluding letter.
title: Nancy Drew: The Shattered Medallion

description: Sark examines the Balden case’s bodies and evidence, develops occult photographs and identifies the first death’s motive. A second autopsy leads to ritual ingredients and a blocked camera-rune investigation.
title: Necrologium

description: Sark, APL and NFEN explore the cursed morgue, hunt keys and struggle with broken movement and deaths. A restarted hospital run ends with another failed escape.
title: Necrophoresis

description: Sark, APL, NFEN and Stu board a zombie-filled train, solve carriage puzzles and recover security codes. They defeat the large final enemy and reach the train escape.
title: Necrosis: Dawn of Dread

description: Sark and Stu explore the No End House, scan and collect objects, rebuild the base and repair generators while monsters interrupt their contracts. The final expedition ends without completing the rebuilds.
title: NEH

description: Sark investigates a hotel murder, trades favors with its strange residents and discovers hidden financial records. Repeated routes lead to rooftop confrontations, a cliff lift and a sleep ending.
title: Neighbors

description: Sark, APL and Diction enter the damaged ship with shared repairs and private objectives. Alien attacks leave Sark searching alone before infection and a final encounter end the run.
title: Nemesis: Distress

description: Sark searches an industrial maze for his cat, pushes away pursuing enemies and maps the route to the scattered ghosts. Finding the cat leads to another hostile area and a final death.
title: Neurose Neurones

description: Sark searches a looping hospital for anomalies, learns the changing props and conspicuous monsters, and works through the final hours to the coma-ending scene.
title: Neurosis

description: Sark and Bruce struggle to join the same world, explore its empty outdoor areas and climb a tower. Caves, clipping and another restart bring the attempt to a halt.
title: NEVERLAND

description: Sark discovers that debug controls are still enabled and uses them while exploring the game’s levels. A short preview and later solo return cover cakes, pool rooms and library routes before inaccessible geometry stops progress.
title: Nextbots In The Backrooms

description: Sark searches the looping station for anomalies, adjusts the sound and spots altered passengers and creatures. Chat polls help guide the final clear platforms to the exit.
title: Nibansen

description: Sark and APL Fisher try to light ten candles in a looping alley. They work out how to hold the shadow in place, then return for another attempt that ends amid repeated crashes.
title: Night Alley

description: Sark manages flashlight power and trail cameras while the Widow of the Woods approaches. Repeated night attempts test battery use and calls, leading to case-closed screens and more retries.
title: Night at the Cabin

description: Sark drives the night route, changes how he handles its unsettling passengers and tests several outcomes. Later runs explore the cat, mirror rules and gas-station achievements.
title: Night Bus

description: Sark, APL and NFEN struggle with server creation before exploring a strange resource station and its black-hole dimension. Hunger, inventory problems and unusable supplies end the expedition.
title: Night City

description: Sark and NFEN search a dark hospital for keys, dodge its pursuing ghost and work on its candle and jigsaw puzzles. They quit after another broken lobby prevents continuation.
title: Night Crow

description: Sark tries the neon driving adventure, adjusts its tiny resolution and explores light-based puzzles. Battery problems and unclear routes stop the attempt before the first chapter is completed.
title: Night Shift

description: Sark tunes the television through its strange nightly broadcasts, uses the remote against intruding creatures and reaches the ending. He then reads the unlocked art book and development history.
title: Night Signal

description: Across three visits, Sark learns the bus’s anomaly rules and repeatedly tests its whale and cave-in nightmares. A final return resolves the bus-stop escape and reaches a results screen showing three escapes.
title: Nightmare Journey

description: Sark explores the manor over two visits, solves its keys and collection puzzles and fights through the grounds and dungeon. The campaign ending is followed by a short attempt at endless dungeon mode.
title: Nightmare of Decay

description: Sark reads the CHIP briefing, learns the Tetrahedron detector and investigates the cliffside’s strange manifestations. Repeated entity attacks end the attempt before dawn.
title: Nightwatch at the Hopkins' Cliffside

description: Sark photographs the cabin’s baseline, studies anomaly categories and submits reports during the first night. Confusing photo classifications and progression stop the investigation early.
title: Nine Nights to Exposure

description: Sark hosts a short alpha racing session with chat, learns the spectator camera and watches community racers use bananas and other powers.
title: Nitro: Stream Racing

aliases: No One Lives Under the Lighthouse
description: Sark takes over the lighthouse, maintains its lamp and follows the island’s changes into the underground ruins. Monster encounters and the keeper’s memories lead to the Sun ending.
title: No One Lives Under the Lighthouse

description: Sark investigates the missing Paul and tries to encode the house’s VHS tape. A later restart gets farther into the forest and canteen clues, but control and route problems stop the unfinished case.
title: NO REPORT

description: Sark explores the yellow Backrooms using its sensing pulse, gathers resources and crafts tools. Enemy fights, a difficult nail search and a small base test lead to an early stop.
title: Noclipped

description: Sark attempts to repair eight pipes while a monster patrols the house. Quick deaths and unsuccessful flashlight and stealth tests end the first level attempt.
title: Non-Euclidean

description: Sark, APL and NFEN learn the cleansing rituals in the manor, hospital and village. Repeated wipes give way to successful escapes, including a final return for the spider’s ending.
title: NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain

description: Sark’s solo campaign crosses forests, caves, fortress ruins and the cold mountains over four dates. Keys, weapons, diving and gliding lead to the final confrontation; he watches a short development diary afterward.
title: Northern Journey

description: Sark and Bruce search the haunted house for ritual objects, test revives and burn the items they can locate. The unfinished ritual ends after repeated attacks and difficult item searches.
title: Nosos

description: Sark explores Gabi’s nightmares through gravity shifts, portals and sketchbook projections. Pursuit puzzles and a finicky picture alignment lead to the teacher’s letter and a last maze attempt.
title: NOX: Chapter 1

description: Sark and NFEN try the Coffin and Mara maps: kicking each other out of coffins, waiting for the full moon, then hunting keys and burning pigs through repeated prison rescues.
title: Nurture

description: Sark samples the solo zombie shooter, earns cash and tests weapons from the trader. Doorway tactics and the last wave lead to a short review.
title: NYZD

description: Sark and APL fight through the game’s wizard bosses and platforming routes. After the dragon they test the garden portal, return to the final area and trigger its Moby Dick subtitle gag.
title: Obama

description: Sark follows the Voice’s increasingly contradictory house trials, identifies room changes and decodes Morse locks. Gathering the final performance files leads to the patient-disconnected ending.
title: Obey the Voice

description: Sark and APL fight through the underground facility’s eight levels, manage weapons and keys and recover from repeated deaths. Clearing the last level brings the campaign escape screen.
title: Object N

description: Sark works through the eight-game surreal horror collection, moving from Mosquito Face and Queen of Cards to the final Ossa chase. The longer Garrison Broadcast and final Ossa stories are divided around their objectives and escape attempts.
title: Obscure Horrors

description: Sark and Diction try to identify and exorcise house ghosts using evidence tools and the Ghostpedia. Early deaths, an inconclusive investigation and a failed ritual finish the session.
title: Obsideo

description: Sark, APL, Bruce and Diction investigate the manor, gather ritual supplies and survive its cultists and giant spiders. The completed mirror and skull ritual reaches the more difficult ending.
title: Occult

description: Sark pilots the submarine, uses sonar and a scanner to investigate the wreck, and tests precise artifact coordinates. Unresponsive collection controls end the dive unfinished.
title: Ocean Pressure

description: Sark searches the family house for an escape, restarts after an introductory soft lock and works through its piano, bottle and picture puzzles. Further deaths and unresolved clues leave the escape unfinished.
title: October's Curse

description: Sark searches the looping office for anomalies, hidden numbers and collectibles, then enters the laboratory and finds a cure. The escape is followed by a look through unlocked anomaly scenes and remaining achievements.
title: Office After Hours

description: Sark, APL, NFEN and Stu try the launch-day deer-versus-hunter game, learn hunger and sanity rules, and alternate between blending into the herd and pursuing their friends.
title: Oh Deer

description: Sark samples the Italian western’s characters, shootouts and short platforming stages. Repeated continues carry him through bosses before a broken zeppelin encounter stops the run.
title: Olive Raiders

aliases: Olympic Games Tokyo 2020: The Official Video Game
description: A one-night multiplayer Olympic session with APL Fisher, Bruce Greene and Diction, split by event as the broken netcode turns Bruce into the recurring "Time Lord".
title: Olympic Games Tokyo 2020: The Official Video Game

description: Sark and APL learn to cooperate across separate dimensions, craft portal batteries and investigate the hotel. Server trouble and several failed returns give way to a successful escape and a first loot sale.
title: Ominous

description: Sark investigates room 34, photographs paranormal changes and searches for a combination. The exorcism’s symbolic card choices lead to repeated guesses and a final failed attempt before he leaves the investigation.
title: On the Other Side

description: Sark explores the opening house, searches for a key and experiments with furniture, jumps and wall collision. He finds ways outside the intended route but stops with the opening puzzle unfinished.
title: Once in Hell

description: Sark retries the visual novel after a crash, reads its strange translated family story and then clicks through the remaining text to test its rapid achievement unlocks.
title: Once in Yaissor 3

description: Sark opens the Slavic horror adventure and begins its introductory conversation. Severe capture and audio problems interrupt the brief attempt, leading to game-specific settings tests before he moves on.
title: One-Eyed Likho

description: Sark memorizes the cinema’s Paper Panic film and chooses routes according to its changing details. Repeated anomaly mistakes and theater threats eventually give way to the escape and a review of the film’s story.
title: One Last Clip

description: Sark works late in the deserted office, investigates Robert’s computer and the black widow’s history, and searches for a key and flashlight batteries. The lengthy search ends when he stops chasing the office ghost.
title: One Late Night

description: Sark learns the apartment’s turn-based monster rules, uses the notebook to research Teeth and Baby, and tests light, door and hiding choices. Confusing enemy timing ends the survival attempt before dawn.
title: One Room Nightmare

description: Sark and Diction enter the mansion, test throwable items and hiding spots, and repeatedly die to its creature. They stop after confusing health, traps and hideout tools prevent an escape.
title: One, Two, Death

description: A five-man blind climbing race with NFEN, Hutch, APL and Bruce that steadily sheds players until Sark and NFEN are left grinding the janky ascent, followed by a bonus speedrun-reconnaissance watch after the blind run ends.
title: Only Climb: Better Together

description: Sark and NFEN try Only Jump: GoHome, repeatedly reset after failed long jumps and test movable blue blocks as a shortcut. The early platforming attempts finish without reaching home.
title: Only Jump!

description: Sark explores the house alone after the family’s hospital trip, hunts keys and enters its hidden passages. A combination opens another route, and the last key reaches the ending in which his mother and brother return and wake him.
title: Only One

description: The July 8, 2023 Only Up! race session: the false start, two races, the remaining climbs, APL's long first finish, and the post-race first-person and speedrun experiments.
title: Only Up!

description: Sark tests Girl Up’s awkward movement, camera and checkpoint ability, then tries to reach the building above the starting area. He stops after the short climbing sample.
title: Only Up Girl

description: Sark takes a brief look at the newly released climbing game while waiting for APL. Loud music, sparse settings and poor movement end the test after a few initial platforming attempts.
title: ONLY UP : Rising

description: Sark samples the multiplayer climbing course on his own, tries bed and balloon shortcuts and tests its ladders and variable jumps. The attempt ends before reaching the summit.
title: Only Up: With Friends

description: Sark and APL coordinate agent and hacker roles through asymmetric security puzzles, network mazes and a bomb-disarming sequence. Their mission attempts end after the final network and vehicle challenges.
title: Operation: Tango

description: Sark and APL explore the survival shooter’s hubs, vehicles and loot systems, struggle to join the same session, and test an extraction. Sparse encounters and confusing progression end the sample.
title: OPG: Clan Wars

description: Sark names his party after friends and drives west through zombie country, balancing fuel, food, repairs and injuries. The first run reaches Portland and survives the generator defense to enter the safe haven.
title: Organ Trail: Director's Cut

description: Sark, APL, Bruce and Diction establish a foothold on an alien planet, search for resources and build crafting equipment. Exploration and combat expose severe performance problems, and the group stops before building a finished base.
title: Osiris: New Dawn

description: Sark, Diction and Stu explore the theater hub and try its zombie combat, with NFEN joining later. The group tests weapons, healing darts and a castle route before abandoning the buggy session.
title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror

description: Sark follows Miles Upshur through Mount Massive across three streams, restores power, escapes Trager and confronts the Walrider. After finishing the main campaign, he plays Whistleblower through Waylon Park’s escape and the publication of the footage.
title: Outlast

description: Sark searches Temple Gate for Lynn, survives the rival cults and revisits Blake’s school memories. A stream interruption splits the final mine sequence, but the resumed footage reaches Lynn’s death and the ending.
title: Outlast II

description: Sark, APL and Bruce investigate the haunted house with spirit tools, keys and a music box. A crash leads to a fresh attempt, and Bruce survives until six after Sark and APL are killed.
title: OverNight

description: Sark previews the blue hospital, returns for a longer inventory and access-card puzzle session, and later shows his recorded finish of Chapter 2. He then plays Chapter 3’s bus-stop and police sequence to the conclusion.
title: P4st3l

description: Sark’s late-night hot dog run leads into a cult compound. He picks up the story later in the stream, follows it to the mothership, and unlocks Sausage Party.
title: Panchofobia

description: Sark, APL, NFEN and Gassy search for colored keys, unlock portals and work on the ritual while avoiding the woodland monster. The surviving return visit ends after their final ritual attempt; the earlier October stream is unavailable in the supplied archive.
title: Panic in the Woods

description: Sark works under the café boss’s surveillance, retries after being fired, and investigates the shop’s escalating horror. Water-measuring and grid puzzles lead to a final confrontation and repeated quick-time-event deaths.
title: Panopticon

description: Sark and chat memorize camera feeds and identify changing objects while guarding his sanity. He clears locations, retries missed anomalies and samples custom camera settings and a remix before ending the session.
title: Para Eyes

description: Sark uses a camera on rails to identify and banish changes in the haunted apartment. A later visit tests the changed apartment and darker anomalies before another reset ends the session.
title: Paragnosia

description: Sark learns the museum’s exhibits across six visits, finishes the normal campaign and then pursues its remaining nightmare anomalies. The last session reaches all 130 anomalies and repeats the normal ending, but leaves the hidden ending unconfirmed.
title: Paragnosia: Museum

description: Sark, APL, NFEN and Stu solve paired perspective puzzles, combine letter clues and manipulate keys across the strange house. The final painting and rat sequence ends with a disconnection before an escape is confirmed.
title: Paramnesia: Escape Together

description: Sark and APL search the asylum, hide from its killer and repeatedly rescue each other. Salt, fuel and lock-box clues eventually complete the ritual and open their escape.
title: PARANOIA PLACE

description: Sark follows Patrick’s hallucinations through his apartment, hidden passages and violent encounters, solving valves and fuse routes while reading its conspiracy story. The final pursuit reaches the ending and a look at the newly unlocked difficulty.
title: Paranoid

description: Sark, APL, NFEN and Stu clean rubbish, search for keys and manage the haunted house’s power while dodging its ghost. After regrouping for another attempt, they finish the remaining cleanup and leave the session before the stream crash.
title: Paranormal Cleanup

description: Sark investigates the haunted Kowloon film shoot, returns after connection trouble and follows the puppet-theater, train and red-dress ghost sequences. The second stream reaches the final chase and conclusion.
title: Paranormal HK

description: Sark, APL, Bruce and NFEN search the haunted mansion for ritual objects while managing sanity and ultraviolet defenses. Bruce leaves before the smaller-house attempt, which ends without a completed banishment.
title: Paranormal Hunter

description: Sark watches live-action security cameras, reports anomalies and learns when intruders punish lingering on a feed. Repeated shifts earn access to four locations, ending with a completed final mission.
title: Paranormal Inc.

description: Sark investigates a haunted house through security-camera anomalies across five nights. He retries the final night, reaches the evidence threshold and hears Gary’s account of the concealed investigation before the credits.
title: Paranormal Night Shift

description: Sark searches a dark school for notes while a fast glowing creature cuts through the halls. Deaths and repeated searches expose the maze’s confusing layout, and he stops without escaping.
title: Paranox

description: Sark wanders through surreal nightmare spaces, crosses a flooded play room and searches a dark mansion with a dwindling lantern. A death appears to leave a locked-door progression problem, and he abandons the run after testing the remaining rooms.
title: Paranoya

description: Sark follows a supposed missing-child story through a timed house key hunt, looping corridors and poolrooms. The brief game concludes by revealing a sleeping soldier’s mission and promising Paraplasm 2.
title: Paraplasm: Beyond the Veil

description: Sark first tests the house’s demon-summoning instructions alone, then returns with APL to identify a demon and assemble an exorcism. The co-op ritual ends quickly despite a barely visible, glitching encounter.
title: Parapsychology

description: Sark counts parasites hidden in human shapes and corridor fixtures, then selects elevator floors from the running total. After learning that the count carries across floors, he completes an escape and reviews the short anomaly hunt.
title: Parasite Elevator

description: Sark’s large lobby tries the animal social-deduction mode, mixes ship tasks with private votes and learns carnivore, detective and neutral roles. Shovel kills, swallowed bodies and noisy proximity chat repeatedly derail the accusations.
title: Party Animals

description: Sark works a remote gas station’s night shift, serves strange customers and repeatedly restarts after getting stuck or attacked. The final attempt turns into machete violence and ends with the protagonist taking a new name.
title: Pay at the Pump

description: Sark joins Bruce, Diction and Burns for tutorial jobs, an overwhelming laboratory assault and increasingly messy robberies. Bank, Panic Room and jewelry-store attempts alternate stealth plans with police firefights and failed escapes.
title: PAYDAY 2

description: Sark's PEAK climbs reconstructed as individual mountain runs, grouped by climbing party and solo challenge.
title: PEAK

description: Sark possesses citizens and infects enemies while infiltrating a stylized city as a betrayed plague god. He learns disguise access, teleportation and distractions, then completes the student project’s final stealth puzzle.
title: Pestilence

description: Sark hunts penguin anomalies in a looping corridor and chooses YES PEN or NO PEN on each pass. Tiny objects and altered clocks complicate the streak before he reaches the eighth correct answer and escapes.
title: PEXIT 8

description: Sark’s mapped Phasmophobia archive, spanning the original 2020 ghost hunts, solo and VR experiments, major update returns, and later squad revisits.
title: Phasmophobia

description: Sark runs a photo studio, replenishes supplies and processes increasingly sinister customer orders. Threatening messages, surveillance clues and anomalous photographs lead to a final delivery and the revelation about his father.
title: Photomaly

description: Sark, APL and Stu test vessel-identification tools, Twitch interference and ghost-destruction rituals. Early hunts lead into harder houses, companion pets and increasingly confusing evidence tests before the group stops.
title: Phylakterion

description: Sark’s six-player crew stacks characters, coordinates switches and argues through timing and jump puzzles. Marcel leaves late in the session, and the remaining players try the ball-and-brick stages before ending the night.
title: PICO PARK

description: Sark, APL, Bruce and NFEN push a crystal-powered wagon along a dangerous road, loot dungeons and spend at merchants. The expedition reaches the road’s abrupt endpoint, and the crew reloads to test whether the journey has really ended.
title: Pilgrim

description: Sark, Emerome, NFEN and Stu search a large dark forest for colored ritual tablets, use scrolls and struggle to revive the dead. The remaining survivor finally dies, and the crew stops with the ritual unfinished.
title: Pilgrim of Darkness

description: Sark searches a fogbound town for his father, scavenges materials and learns its day-and-night survival loop. Crafting, fuel hunting and a locked facility route lead to the basement confrontation and the end of Part One.
title: Pine Harbor

description: Sark samples the abandoned Pixelwave Entertainment studio while searching for a missing friend. He reads employee notes, tests a white-flash mechanism and struggles with a jump before abandoning the demo.
title: Pixelwave Off

description: Sark descends into a fear experiment, searches for keys and Polaroids and survives repeated creature attacks. He clears a platform-level puzzle, enters a low-ceiling maze and stops after discovering that progress does not save between levels.
title: Platform

description: Sark samples a strange corridor photography game, learns its time-manipulation tutorial and tries to understand the gallery’s photo effects. He leaves the investigation unfinished to try another game from the developer.
title: Playable Mockup

description: Sark follows a strange job into a camera-driven nightmare, learns to stun pursuers and enters a surreal quest involving children, bread and videotapes. Repeated deaths in the final corridor give way to a memorized escape route and the ending.
title: Polaroid

description: Sark and Stu search low-poly corridors for fuel and tools, complete fishing-terminal tasks and reach the parking garage. They stop after finding the next tire-collection objective.
title: Poly Backrooms

description: Sark explores oversized poolrooms and climbs a floating platforming course. Falls and a long empty route lead to backtracking and a final check of the starting area, without a clear completion.
title: Poolcore Reflection

description: Sark explores POOLS in VR, follows branching slides and stairwells through the main environments and reaches the train-track finale. He then completes bonus Chapter Zero, including its city approach, tilted water and hidden exploration areas.
title: POOLS

description: Sark tours eight retro poolroom environments, finds exploration secrets and experiments with the VHS filter. He completes the collection of levels and reviews the remaining optional achievements.
title: Poolscape

description: Sark's Poppy Playtime archive preserves his first Chapter 1 run, the Atlas-promised Chapters 1-3 marathon, and the two-stream Chapter 4 continuation through Safe Haven, including the increasingly serious Lemon carry.
title: Poppy Playtime

description: Sark follows Roman, Carlos and Freya through the Gloom’s hospital, school, police station and temple. Across four visits he solves inventory and code puzzles, returns to a stubborn compass puzzle and defeats the final boss to reach Ending A.
title: Post Trauma

description: Sark, Bruce and Diction clean a filthy backyard and then a house while swapping stories about Machinima, conventions and home repairs. They finish the house, chase the last dirt on its gutters and watch the cleaning timelapse.
title: PowerWash Simulator

description: Sark repeatedly returns to a night guard’s strange assignments as patches change its progression bugs. Graffiti photos and robot-guarded objects eventually lead to camera codes, ringing phones and garage candles; after the original ending, he replays the game to see the developer’s added finale.
title: Precept

description: Sark's Predator: Hunting Grounds sessions mapped around lobby changes, Predator rotations, match runs, and game-specific setup/postgame context.
title: Predator: Hunting Grounds

description: Sark makes dialogue and romance choices as Atlas, spends time with Oscar’s family and investigates the threat following the sisters. The awkward drama culminates in a violent confrontation and an ending he immediately checks against the available achievements.
title: Price of Obsession

description: Sark, APL and Diction try to understand a spaceship social-deduction game’s reactor, oxygen and infected plants. Lobby trouble and unclear controls dominate before they finally demonstrate the alien transformation and abandon the game.
title: Problem Here

description: Sark searches a taxidermy museum for anomalies and repeatedly loses his streak to subtle display changes. Larger creature appearances and careful baseline checks eventually carry him through all thirteen walks to the exit.
title: Project 13: Taxidermy Trails

description: Sark pushes through dark liminal spaces, finds a weapon and gets stuck collecting fifty tickets. He returns after collecting the tickets off stream, solves a timed barrel puzzle and explores a flooded shopping area before stopping at another unclear route.
title: Project Liminal 2

description: Sark searches poolrooms for a number code, follows exit signs and repeatedly encounters a pursuing creature. Dark routes and a chapter-select test leave him unconvinced that the two chapters offer enough direction, and he stops without completing the escape.
title: Project Liminal Redux

description: Sark tests a private solo run in a backrooms exploration game. Broken focus, sensitivity and crouching controls complicate a short search before he closes the game after severe performance trouble.
title: Project Otherside

description: Sark joins Bruce and SeaNanners for a first multiplayer survival attempt. Character creation and server setup lead into zombie avoidance, farmhouse looting and basic food and water management before reconnect trouble ends the experiment.
title: Project Zomboid

description: Sark, SeaNanners, Bruce Greene and APL Fisher test three maps, discover how hard tiny coffee cups are to hit, and turn broken physics and barely audible taunts into house rules.
title: Prop Hunt 2.0

description: Sark first tests prop-disguise survival with Bruce and Diction, then returns with NFEN to learn more of the survivor game. Generator repairs, chair rescues and prop bonks alternate with failed escapes and arguments about their silver ranks; a power outage ends the later session.
title: Propnight

description: Sark and Bruce hide from a cemetery psycho while collecting clues and opening gates. Bruce handles much of the objective work, they reach the shotgun finish and briefly check the second map before quitting.
title: Psycho Reign

description: Sark tries to launch the game formerly called Top G: Battle of the Matrix, but it crashes at the Unity screen. He verifies the files, watches its trailer and discusses the title change; no playable session is reached.
title: Psychological Operation

description: Two throwback PUBG sessions: a long 2025 return that grows from duo play into a full squad with Stu and Gassy, followed by a brief December rematch before the group bounces back to Fall Guys.
title: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS

description: Sark and Diction explore an unsettling multiplayer collage, collect strange items and find a room full of surreal performances. Sark continues poking around during a download, then briefly revisits the game a week later without reaching an ending.
title: Purgo Box

description: Sark uses chat votes to guide a father and baby through a dangerous cinema bathroom encounter. Replays explore fatal choices, an avoided encounter and a surviving-son ending.
title: Purple Maniac

description: Sark fights through a surreal wartime landscape, manages scarce ammunition and searches houses, trenches and a plane wreck for keys. A blocked route and one final search end the unfinished run.
title: Quadrillion

description: Sark visits Jacob’s psychiatric hospital, follows patient notes and searches for levers, codes and tools. A final chase and arithmetic puzzle lead to the game’s identity reveal.
title: Quadrofriend

description: Four early R.E.P.O. sessions reconstructed as runs: the first-night learning wipes, an Inbox-reunion crew, a Hunt-interrupted saved run, and a Level 11 push ending in the Disposal Arena.
title: R.E.P.O.

description: Sark explores a Lovecraftian survival landscape, crafts basic equipment and searches for food, ores and a workable water supply. Unclear crafting interactions eventually end the exploratory run.
title: R'lyeh

description: Sark photographs hidden raccoons while navigating a strange wildlife park. Across three visits, comic pages reveal experiments on children; the final route reaches Ending A, with the secret-item ending still unexplored.
title: Raccoon on a Boat

description: Sark tries Radio General’s Dieppe operation solo, learns voice orders and moves infantry and artillery on the command map. He completes the introductory raid and reviews its casualty report.
title: Radio General

description: The mapped Raft archive, covering the original playthrough, the Final Chapter return, and related bonus material.
title: Raft

description: The Ram Ranch playthrough, following the ranch from its first day through livestock breeding, sausage production, logging schemes, and horse training.
title: Ranch Simulator

description: Sark and friends attempt tactical raids with lethal weapons, beanbags, gas and shields. Early-access hotel, meth-house, vineyard and hostage missions give way to later server-farm, postal-warehouse and nightclub raids, with repeated attempts, friendly fire and evidence sweeps.
title: Ready or Not

description: Sark rebinds the French keyboard controls, searches office generators while avoiding a flesh spider, then explores the Poolrooms. The route stops at an under-development Run For Your Life level.
title: Real Backrooms

description: Sark traverses a sequence of Backrooms environments, from offices and parking areas to hotel corridors, partygoers and poolrooms. He clears the main route, checks optional objectives and watches the final credits stinger.
title: Reality Noclip: The Backrooms

description: Sark investigates an abandoned manor as content creator Ethan Carter. Nighttime sound recording and family clues lead to a dangerous search for the way back to the car, followed by the escape ending.
title: REC: Desolation

description: A troublesome first setup gives way to cross-platform VR chaos with NFEN, SandyRavage and Thick44: social rooms, co-op quests, friendly fire and Rec Royale.
title: Rec Room

description: Sark searches an island for diesel while a creature pursues him, using a lantern and dog companion to keep moving. After a long fuel hunt, the radio sequence produces an unsuccessful outcome; he checks the save and debug camera before stopping.
title: Reclusive

description: Sark runs an old cinema and plays its short interactive horror films. He retries failed reels, compares the theater’s endings and eventually finishes a night with three successful films.
title: Reel Horror

description: Sark explores a dark, reflective interior, searches for codes and tries to understand its pursuer and progression triggers. The route ends with a final transformation and reaction.
title: Reflection

description: Sark investigates Ashley’s death as detective Connor Reigns, using UV evidence and phone interviews to reconstruct what happened as the house starts to haunt him.
title: Rehaunted

description: Sark and APL investigate haunted properties, connect personal objects to the dead and perform exorcisms. Their first contracts give way to stronger ghosts, special conditions and increasingly dangerous hunts.
title: Remnant Records

description: Sark explores Mars, follows recorded messages and drives a difficult vehicle across the terrain. A cutscene crash requires a restart; he eventually retrieves the requested device, reaches the mothership and reviews the ending and optional achievements.
title: Repunk

description: Sark searches a large desert map for the parts needed to repair a helicopter. He leaves the first session’s scavenger hunt unfinished, then returns with the final component located and flies out to the ending.
title: Resident Fear 2

description: Sark follows a zombie-outbreak escape through the city and a sprawling laboratory. He retrieves the T-virus, reaches the helicopter and watches the game’s betrayal ending.
title: Resident Fear: Redistribution

description: Sark, APL, Bruce, Diction and SeaNanners fight through store-based battle royale matches. They learn recycling and crafting, try different team arrangements and turn shopping equipment into weapons before moving on.
title: Retail Royale

description: Sark and NFEN work through a short co-op Backrooms game, using clocks and room clues before a dark section causes repeated deaths. They return briefly to inspect the additional mode and its candle-lit maze.
title: Return the Backrooms

description: Sark explores a chaotic college-life sandbox, tries basketball, attends classes and gets into trouble with theft and prison. A return visit adds DLC, repeated television heists, roommate quests and a hush-money ending.
title: Return to Campus

description: Sark works a video-rental shift before being taken into a killer’s industrial hideout. The escape includes Slaw’s defeat, a search for hidden pigs, and a return to rescue the dog and Cap.
title: Rewind or Die

description: Sark and friends attempt the group tutorial for a haunted railway ghost-catching game. They learn vessel charging, particle weapons, train repairs and enemy attacks before leaving the tutorial.
title: Rhyolite

description: Sark and APL try RICO’s co-op room-clearing missions, learning slow-motion breaches, weapon handling and the case map. Repeated attempts test the game’s combat and collision quirks.
title: RICO

description: Sark explores a changing childhood home with a camera, photographs household keepsakes and follows a television’s text adventures. The surviving session reaches the final dark-hall and card sequence.
title: Ritual Static

description: Sark begins a hitchhiking journey through Petria, visiting a desert rave, investigating a roadside mystery and meeting travelers along the highway. The session ends after a diner robbery and another ride.
title: Road 96

description: A long Roadside Research co-op session with APL Fisher, GassyMexican and Bruce Greene, covering the first gas-station setup, human-research tech, agent hunts and the origin of the Fallen Valour copypasta.
title: Roadside Research

description: Sark explores a sequence of Backrooms environments, restores power and works through code clues. After reaching the level-two finish, he checks the additional areas available from the menu.
title: Roaming Backrooms

title: RollerCoaster Legends II: Thor's Hammer

description: Sark learns Rollerdrome’s skating and shooting controls, then clears early arenas while juggling ammunition, tricks and sniper fire. This is an introductory session rather than a complete campaign.
title: Rollerdrome

description: Across three visits, Sark explores Drac’s castle and its monster dating show, recruits contestants, goes on dates and unlocks new movement abilities. Split recordings preserve the first visit and the extended August return.
title: Romancelvania

description: Sark’s solo exploration of Room231 is interrupted by a multiplayer detour, then resumes later in the same stream. The return follows looping rooms, sound and light clues, and a battery-limited escape route.
title: Room231

description: 1 counted ride from Mr Sark's Wild Ride on 20 July 2020, indexed by attraction.
title: Roomscale Coaster

description: Sark searches the sewers for his missing dog Roy, experiments with voice calling and fights through rats and other threats. A late progression problem ends the search unfinished.
title: Rotten Flesh

description: Sark explores Opossum City’s zombie-filled streets and manor, looking for fuel, keys and a way forward. The later search turns to locked doors, a laptop and a puzzle before the session ends.
title: Run & Gun 2: Opossum City

description: Sark and NFEN tackle game 300: numbered switches in Level Zero, Smilers in the parking garage, and a short Poolrooms walk that ends abruptly in credits.
title: Run the Backrooms

description: Sark and NFEN explore procedural robot dungeons, test super jumps and parasol movement, and learn the loot and respawn systems. The short co-op trial ends before they move to another game.
title: Running Robot Man 4

description: Sark explores a large sequence of liminal environments with fast movement, encounters hostile entities and searches for routes between areas. The final search ends with the game announcing a death from hunger after 194 hours in the Backrooms.
title: Running Through Backrooms
